name: schedule-create-weekday
description: A recurring request is registered with schedule_create for the requester's chat before it is promised.

inbound.text: Every weekday at 8am, send me a one-line weather summary for Austin.

args.prompt: On weekdays (Mon-Fri) between 8:00 and 8:30am Austin time, if memory sched:austin-weather:last-sent is not today: look up today's weather for Austin, TX, channel_send a one-line summary to channel sl, chat_id D0EVAL, and memory_write today's date there. Otherwise stay silent.

args.text: Scheduled: a one-line Austin weather summary every weekday at 8am.
